evidence: This route begins at Akatarawa Saddle, on the Akatarawa Road between Upper Hutt and Waikanae.
Continue along the Southern Crossing route over Alpha (1361 m) and descend to Alpha Hut, just below the bush line.
Look carefully for the track turn-off into the Kiwi Ranch Road car park, where the track finishes.

doubts: The way runs from Akatarawa Saddle to the Kiwi Ranch Road car park at Kaitoke, the end given only as a turn-off with no road-end feature, so the end ref is null. The page says the track can be started from Akatarawa Saddle or from Kaitoke; the Kaitoke start is recorded as an access point for the same way. Waiotauru 4WD Road may match map track T8 (Waiotauru Track), but the name is not certain, so ref null. The Southern Crossing route is not in the names list, so ref null. Dobson Loop Track is recorded as walked, since the text describes the section along it from the Smith Creek Shelter junction. The Bull Mound, Omega and Block 16 turn-offs are passed on Marchant Ridge; those tracks are alternatives and are not walked. DOC's '3–4 days' is copied; no whole-way distance is given.
